long_biography.plain_text:
Before Purolite, Brodie managed a law firm, experience she later applied to a young manufacturing company operating from her family home. She designed the administrative and finance systems that supported its expansion. As the business became an international supplier of purification resins for pharmaceutical and industrial uses, she remained a source of guidance and leadership.

Following Purolite’s acquisition by Ecolab, Brodie’s public work has centred on structured philanthropy. She serves as co-managing trustee of the Don and Linda Brodie Family Foundation and chairs the FamilyMatters board, supporting services for children and families. Her education giving includes university research funds and a named deanship. Her board and foundation work now directs charitable capital toward education, research and long-term support for community institutions.
